metadata.description: Character occupations: 32 different occupations with starting bonuses
metadata.notes: Each occupation includes name, description, and detailed career benefits

occupations.name: Arms collector
occupations.desc: Knowledge about arms, arms engineering, gun modification and gun history
details: Start the game with one of each of these OLD weapons : Colt Predator, Skalan Grudge, Akama 120 Rifle, Frontier Savage and a Hakari D.I.N.O Machine Gun. You also have a lvl 4 arms contact that specializes in RARE and EXOTIC weapons. **You don't have the legal permit to carry those weapons.
Starting funds: 200k
Gain a SMALL bonus to either GUNSLINGER and ENGINEERING or  MARKSMANand TECHNOLOGY

occupations.name: Corporate
occupations.desc: Corporate knowledge, who's in charge, protocols and hierarchy.
details: Effect: Start the game with an investment that nets you 50k credits a month and two level 4 corporate contact.
Starting funds: 100k credits
Gain a SMALL bonus to either LEADERSHIP and ETIQUETTE or TECHNOLOGY and INTUITION

occupations.name: Diplomat
occupations.desc: Deep understanding of etiquette and relation between the major entities of the alliance
details: Start the game with a level 4 ALLIANCE contact, a set of formal wear and a prepaid cheap quality clone. The clinic also has 1 pre-paid backup that can be performed at any time.
Starting funds: 100k
Gain a SMALL bonus to either CHARM and SUBTERFUGE or NEGOTIATION and ETIQUETTE.

occupations.name: Drug Dealer
occupations.desc: Scientific background, chemical based knowledge, laboratory work and pharmacology
details: Start with a small car (worth 100k)  and 150k of illegal drugs/poison (common or uncommon).  You also have a drug contact at lvl 4
Starting funds 150k
Gain a SMALL bonus to either SCIENCE and ACADEMIC or to SCAVENGING and MEDICINE

occupations.name: Entertainer
occupations.desc: Knowledge of the basic hierarchy of your entertainement field, general social etiquette
details: You have potential!  Start the game with a High End Musical Instrument and Designer Clothings. You also have either 2 level 4 contacts or 3 level 2 contacts related to the entertainment industry.
Starting funds: 100k
Gain a SMALL bonus to either FLAIR and ETIQUETTE or ACTING and CHARM

occupations.name: Ex. Cultist
occupations.desc: Very little knowledge of society as you were brainwashed by a cult. You left a TRONIK worship cult believing that all of society is a simulation.
details: Start with the clothes on your back,  and an EVO1 Cybernetic Scrambler (Not installed) . You literraly pulled that out of your cult leader while running away.
Starting funds 100k, you escaped with nothing.
Gain a a SMALL bonus to CHARM , INTIMIDATE and INTUITION

occupations.name: Explorer
occupations.desc: You worked as a surveyor for the many corporations wishing to colonize and exploit dark space worlds.
details: Start with a "Reinforced" Darkspace Survivor armor with Grav Boots and a Distress Beacon. You also have a Hunting Shotgun and a Barret 180 Sniper + start with a lvl 4 salvage and a lvl 4 space contact.
Starting funds: 200k
Gain a SMALL bonus to either SURVIVAL and MARKSMAN or SCANVENGE and GUNSLINGER

occupations.name: Investigator
occupations.desc: Knowledge of law inforcement, basic underground knowledge, black market, gangs.
details: Start the game a with a restrictred licence,a Blaster Pistol and an Acer A1000. You also have a lvl 4 contact as a criminal informant and another lvl 4 contact in law enforcement.
Starting funds 200k
Gain a SMALL bonus to either SUBTERFUGE and SEARH or CONCEALMENT and STREETWISE

occupations.name: Law enforcement
occupations.desc: You have a past working as or with law enforcement.
details: Effect: Start the game with a "GU-22 Police Drone", a restricted license and a level 4 law contact.
Starting funds: 200k
Gain a SMALL bonus to either INTIMIDATE and MARTIAL ARTS or ACADEMICS and STREETWISE

occupations.name: Mage
occupations.desc: ETIQUETTE amongst the spiritual community, cultists and magical beings.
details: Start with a level 4 paranormal contact and an EMPTY Intermediate RELIC of your choice and 2 empty spell shards.
Starting funds: 150k
Gain a SMALL bonus to SPIRITUAL, BINDING and either INTUITION or RESILIENCE

occupations.name: Outlaw
occupations.desc: Underworld knowledge, black market, gangs, who's in charge and general etiquette.
details: Effect: Start the game with 2 level 4 contacts, and a Johnny C at 4.
Starting funds: 150k and a stolen item that must be fenced worth 200k
Gain a SMALL bonus to either SUBTERFUGE and CONCEALMENT or STREETWISE and DEXTERITY

occupations.name: Scientific
occupations.desc: Scientific background, know who's who within the SCIENCE community and how to conduct yourself amongst them.
details: Start the game with a Securicorp Model 1 Datacom with the Workshop program and  level 4 SCIENCE contact.
Starting funds: 100k credits,  research/SCIENCE gear valued at up to 100k credits and a Eggshell Type 2 drone to cary your SCIENCE stuff around..
Gain a SMALL bonus to either MEDICINE and SCIENCE or ACADEMIC and GALACTIC KNOWLEDGE

occupations.name: Soldier
occupations.desc: Military knowledge, who does what, who's in charge, lingo etc.
details: Effect:  one weapon valued under 100 000 credits (any legality but nothing above RARE), a Light Infantry armor (with 40k worth of options) , a level 4 military contact and a level 4 fixer.
Starting funds: 200k credits
Gain a SMALL bonus from two of the following :  DEMOLITION, HEAVY WEAPONS, TACTICS and MARKSMAN

occupations.name: Pilot
occupations.desc: Understanding of life in space, where to get things, how to travel as well as the dangers associated with it.
details: Effect: Start the game with a level 4 space contact and a spaceship worth less than 5 milions (that you still have to pay 4.5 million credits on)..
Starting funds: 100k
Gain a SMALL bonus to PILOT and NAVIGATION or SURVIVAL and REPAIR

occupations.name: Trader
occupations.desc: You have experience brokering trade deals, sending freight across the galaxy and managing personnel.
details: Effect: Start the game a with a lvl 4 corporate contact or a lvl 4 gang contact and a vehicle of your choice valued under 500k.
Starting funds: 100k
Gain a SMALL bonus to either NEGOTIATION and CHARM or SCAVENGING and STREETWISE

occupations.name: Virtual Activist
occupations.desc: You worked or spent a significant amount of time online in the virtual communities.
details: Effect: Start the game with a datacom + software up to 200k value and a level 4 computer contact.
Starting funds: 100k and a drone worth up to 250k.
Gain a SMALL bonus to either CYBERINTEL and HACKING or TECHNOLOGY and OPERATOR

occupations.name: Worker
occupations.desc: Working man knowledge, how to interact with them, unions and general  etiquette
details: Start the game with a level 4 contact of your choice and a living space fully furnished worth up to  200k. The living space is paid for 3 months.  You have a clean ID and the right to live for a full year.
Starting funds: 200k
Gain a SMALL bonus to either JOURNEYMAN and SCAVENGING or SCIENCE and ENGINEERING.

occupations.name: Bounty Hunter
occupations.desc: An old fashion cowboy, making end's meet chasing down various bounties
details: Start the game with a rank 5 (lowest) Bounty hunter license, a paralizer rifle and a level 4 law contact.
Starting funds: 75k
Gain a SMALL bonus to either INTIMIDATION and MARTIAL ARTS or CYBERINTEL and GUNSLINGER.

occupations.name: Transporter
occupations.desc: You handle express delivery of sensitive cargo or VIPs between worlds.
details: Start the game with a level 4 corporate contact of your choice and a spaceship worth less than 5 milions (that you still have to pay 4.5 million credits on).
Starting funds: 100k
Gain a SMALL bonus to either PILOTING and ETIQUETTE or NEGOTIATION and JOURNEYMAN.

occupations.name: Bartender
occupations.desc: You've worked most of your life as a bartender in a high trafic area. You met and befriended many different clients  hailing from all sorts of places. Your friend list is now longer than your resume and you picked up quite a few interesting bits of knowledge by being the local :Booze therapist".
details: Start the game with either 4 level 4 contacts or 8 level 2 contacts
Starting funds : 150k
Gain a SMALL bonus to either CHARM and SUBTERFUGE or to FLAIR and ETIQUETTE

occupations.name: Hooverboard Pro
occupations.desc: From streetpunk hooverjock to alliance wide recognized professional X-Boarder. Society labelled you as a useless bum, now they pay you to be one. Given time you are convinced that you will show everyone just how wrong they were about you.
details: Start the game with a Dragonboard8 and an advanced camera drone.  You also have one level 4 contact Agent, and an other level 4 marketing specialist
Starting funds : 200k
Gain a SMALL bonus to either PILOTING and FLAIR or ATHLETIC and NAVIGATION

occupations.name: Influencer
occupations.desc: Ever wanted to see every single tourist hellhole in the galaxy, then this is the job for you. You are paid to "influence" people and hype up shitholes in order to attract tourism. On the plus side you are always on the move and this gives a lot of free time for "sidejobs".
details: You have a sponsor that either provides a revenue of 50k per month or provides you no revenues but gives you free promotionnal material from time to time. Also, you have two level 4 contacts related to tourism.
Starting funds : 100k
Gain a SMALL bonus to ETIQUETTE and Galactic Knowledge or to CHARM and SUBTERFUGE

occupations.name: Life Extension Technician
occupations.desc: Yeap, im the guy providing rich assholes with their life extension. You got the credits, I have the proverbial immortality pill. You know what's the best and worst part of the job? The secrets; so many secrets it would make a conspiracy theorist's head spin.
details: Start the game with a level 4 contact in a cloning facility and a level 4 contact that was a past client from the time your work in clone tech.
Starting funds : 200k and a stolen backup from a famous past client that was "lost" that is worth at least 300k
Gain a SMALL bonus to MEDICINE  and ETIQUETTE or TECHNOLOGY and SCIENCE

occupations.name: Junker
occupations.desc: You know what's the best part of a global war that wipes half the galaxy? The salvage opportunities! So much junk everywhere that you can go just about anywhere and make a profit. Some of that junk will try to kill you but don't let that minor inconvenience turn you away from such an great opportunity.
details: Start the game with a level 4 space pirate contact and a Lazarfeld Survey Drone
Starting funds : 200k
Gain a SMALL bonus to SCAVENGING and NAVIGATION or to REPAIR and RESILIENCE

occupations.name: TRONIK disposal specialist
occupations.desc: The TRONIK war left a lot of dangerous AI's dormant everywhere. You worked as part of an alliance team in charge of AI cleanup. You are all that is left of that team and figured now was a good time to seek new career opportunities.
details: Start the game with an Orion MBT 33 Full Datacom loaded with the OrionWorks Publi-X program. You also know a lvl 4 program and tech reseller.
Starting funds : 100k and a datachip containing an AI that you never got rid of yet. (Maybe could be sold for 200k on the market)
Gain a SMALL bonus to HACKING and CYBERINTEL or to TECHNOLOGY and OPERATOR

occupations.name: Nova Canon Operator
occupations.desc: They say you should dream big! For you that dream was a tad bigger than most. For as long as you remember, your dream was to operate that BIG canon you saw on TV as a child. Yes, the one that blows's up planets! Years of work and training eventually got you there, you had the BIG gun to yourself. You are now dishonorably discharged and forbiden from telling anyone what happened.
details: You loooove explosives and big things. Start the game with a Scatterbrain Canon that you clearly DO NOT have the permit to posess.  You also know someone who sells things that goes boom (level 4 contact) and an other level 4 contact that provides "opportunities".
Starting funds : 100k and 80k worth of explosives (common or uncommon)
Gain a SMALL bonus to ENGINEERING and TECHNOLOGY or HEAVY WEAPONS and  TACTICS

occupations.name: Ripperdoc
occupations.desc: Dirty clinic in a weird back alley? Sure, you can call it that but are you sure you want to be picky when half the blood on my floor is curently yours? Leave common sense at home kid, that's where mine is….
details: Start with a level 4 contact in medical supplies and an uninstalled GENETICS EVO 1 (common or uncommon) under 100k.
Starting funds : 200k and 2 level 5 skillschips you could try to sell for around 150k each
Gain a SMALL bonus to SCIENCE and MEDICINE or TECHNOLOGY and SCAVENGING

occupations.name: Auctionneer
occupations.desc: If there's a deal to be done you will be the one handling it. You have a reputation for buying and selling just about anything not nailed down to the floor. Acquisitions, resale, upsell you name it. Now that the presentations are out of the way, can I interest you in buying half a ton of Slave Bits at an almost criminal discount?
details: Start the game with an antique motorcycle (worth 300k), a level 4 contact in antiques and rare items and a level 4 contact that holds secret auctions.
Starting funds : 100k
Gain a SMALL bonus to GALACTIC KNOWLEDGE and to  NEGOTIATION or to ACADEMIC and CHARM

occupations.name: Corporate Thief
occupations.desc: You used to be angry against corporations, even went as far as commit a few crimes against some of them but then something weird happened:  Someone offered you a job to keep doing what you love. Some would call you a thief, but that's such a negative term, you prefer intelligence reallocation specialist yourself.
details: Start the game with 1 million worth of damaging information on a corporation. (Leaking it may be extremely dangerous for you). You also know a lvl 4 contact fencer and a level 4 corporate informant.
Starting funds : 250k and a Gusto's little helper drone.
Gain a SMALL bonus to HACKING and  SUBTERFUGE or to DEXTERITY and TECHNOLOGY

occupations.name: Fortuneteller
occupations.desc: The first thing you remember seeing were the colors; a beautiful glistening crimson red, later on came the hearing, loud crashing noises. Every specialist claimed you were insane or had a vivid imagination till the day a car slammed through your bedroom wall smashing your parents to bits and repainting the walls red. It turns ou you're not insane, you can glimpse the future.
details: Start the game with two empty intermediate relics and a level 4 contact who brings your clients that generates a revenue of 50k per month.
Starting funds : 50k
Gain a SMALL bonus to SPIRITUAL and INTUITION or to  SUBTERFUGE and BINDING

occupations.name: Pyromaniac
occupations.desc: The world is an ugly place, things as are much prettier when they burn. Friends used to call me a Pyromaniac, not anymore. One could say that I've burnt that bridge, hehe, hahahahaha!
details: Start the game with a Plasma Pistol and a small car powered by corontia. You know someone (level 4 contact) that can sell you  chemicals and explosives. You also know someone specialized in elementalist magic (contact level 4)
Starting funds : 100k and up to 200k in explosives up to RARE (must explode or deal ENERGY damage).
Gain a SMALL bonus to ENGINEERING and SALVAGE or TECHNOLOGY and HEAVY WEAPONS

occupations.name: Mercenary
occupations.desc: You take jobs from whoever is willing to pay. Wether you have scrupules or not is up to you.
details: Start the game with up to 400k worth of weapons, defenses and EVO's. You also have a Fixer (contact level 4)
Starting funds 50k, everything else was spent on your gear.
Gain a SMALL bonus to HEAVY WEAPONS and MARTIAL ARTS or CONCEALMENT and MARKSMAN

notes.usage: Character builder occupation selection, starting benefits
